---
title: Positron and renv profile startup recovery
date: 2026-11-11
---

## Objective

Restore a responsive interactive R console in Positron while preserving automatic activation of
the project renv library.

## Evidence

- A direct Rscript activation of renv completes in about three seconds.
- Ark logs an Unexpected longjump while it is sourcing the project .Rprofile, followed by a
  tree_sitter_r backtrace.
- Disabling only the profile call that sources renv/activate.R restores a responsive console.

## Planned change

Define .First in .Rprofile and source renv/activate.R from that startup hook for ordinary R
sessions. Ark does not invoke .First, so configure its kernel environment with R_LIBS_USER pointing
to the project library. R recognizes this variable during startup, before Ark processes the user
profile; this avoids the failing renv bootstrap while preserving access to project packages.
Restrict .First to interactive R so targets callr children do not re-enter the problematic renv
bootstrap; these children inherit R_LIBS_USER from the Positron kernel.

## Verification

1. Start a clean Rscript process and verify that R_LIBS_USER places the project library first.
2. Restart R in Positron and confirm that the prompt becomes ready without sustained Ark CPU use.
3. Confirm that a package available through the project library can load before treating the
   workaround as stable. Restore missing lockfile packages separately if needed.

## Result

The Positron console restarted without sustained Ark CPU use after a full close and reopen.
Its library path included the project renv library, and `find.package("targets")` resolved there.
Reloading the window alone did not apply the kernel environment setting.
The initial version of `.First()` still ran in noninteractive targets callr children and reproduced
the renv startup loop. Restricting it with `interactive()` allowed `tar_outdated()` to start and
surface the next pipeline-definition error instead.

## Rollback

Restore the direct source call in .Rprofile if the console fails to start or the project library
is not activated.
